stem: Which of the following is not a breed of Rajasthan?

options.label: e
options.text: None of the above / More than one of the above

expl: Hallikar is a cattle breed of Karnataka. Tharparkar, Rathi, and Mewati are cattle breeds of Rajasthan. The Mewati breed is related to the Mewat region. Earlier, the Mewat region included southern Delhi, Alwar and Bharatpur (Rajasthan), Mathura (Uttar Pradesh), and some parts of Haryana. In 2016, Haryana’s Mewat district was renamed Nuh.

stem: Most rich state in minerals in India is –

stem: Which State of India is called as the State of Minerals ?
expl: Jharkhand is known as the “State of Minerals and Salts”, because it has a wide range of mineral resources such as coal, iron ore, bauxite, and chromite. The state makes a significant contribution to India’s total mineral production. However, in its answer key, the Bihar Public Service Commission marked option (a) as the correct answer for this question.

stem: The two states of India, most richly endowed with iron ore, are
expl: According to the Indian Minerals Yearbook, 2024. The iron ore reserves (hematite and magnetite) in the given states are as follows: Odisha (9,409,331 thousand tonnes), Madhya Pradesh (356,999 thousand tonnes—only hematite), and Bihar (49,439 thousand tonnes). Therefore, for the given question, option (c), Bihar and Odisha, is the correct answer. In India, the major states rich in iron ore (hematite and magnetite) are Karnataka (10,638,163 thousand tonnes), Odisha (9,409,573 thousand tonnes), Jharkhand (4,720,813 thousand tonnes), and Chhattisgarh (4,641550 thousand tonnes). States having hematite deposits include Odisha, Jharkhand, Chhattisgarh, Karnataka, and Goa, while states with magnetite dominance include Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh, Rajasthan, Tamil Nadu, and Goa.

stem: Which of the following Iron ores is mined at Bailadila?

options.label: e
options.text: None of the above/More than one of the above

expl: The Bailadila mining area is located in Dantewada district of Chhattisgarh. Hematite iron ore is mined here. Hematite is a high-grade iron ore. It is mainly found in Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, Odisha, Karnataka, Maharashtra, Andhra Pradesh, and Goa. Magnetite iron ore is found mainly in Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh, Rajasthan, Tamil Nadu, and Goa.

stem: Which of the following States has the largest deposits of copper ore?

options.label: e
options.text: None of the above / More than one of the above

expl: According to the Indian Minerals Yearbook, 2024. The largest reserve of copper ore in India is found in Rajasthan. It is followed by Madhya Pradesh and Jharkhand. About 90.67 percent of the total copper ore reserves are concentrated in these three states. Copper is an important non-ferrous metal. India is not self-sufficient in copper production.

stem: Where was first coal mine in India mined?

options.label: e
options.text: None of the above/More than one of the above

expl: The first coal mine in India was dug at Raniganj, on the bank of the Damodar River. This work began in 1774 A.D. as an exploration/discovery, whereas regular mining is considered to have started from 1820.

stem: The Korba coalfield is located in –
expl: The Korba coalfield is located in Korba district of Chhattisgarh in the Hasdeo River basin. It is the major coalfield of the state. The Korba Thermal Power Plant is also located nearby.

stem: The oldest oil field in India is –
expl: The oldest oilfield in India is located at Digboi in Assam. It lies in the Brahmaputra Valley, which is the oldest petroleum-producing region of the country.

stem: Which State in India is the leading producer of Thorium?

expl: Among the given options, Kerala is the leading state with respect to thorium. Monazite is the principal source of thorium. IREL (India) Limited separates thorium through chemical processing of monazite at its plant located at Udyogamandal (Aluva) in Ernakulam district.
